run_inference_on_dataset: run inference on a model with a data loader and evaluator, benchmarking speed and returning evaluation results
create_dataset_evaluator: create a custom DatasetEvaluator subclass that implements process and evaluate methods for a detection task
combine_evaluators: combine multiple DatasetEvaluator instances into a single DatasetEvaluators wrapper for joint evaluation
use_inference_context: use inference_context as a context manager to temporarily set a model to eval mode and restore training mode afterwards
benchmark_inference_speed: benchmark model inference speed per iteration across devices with warmup, data loading, compute, and eval timing
